title: docs: correct manage_connections tool presence in tool-search guide
claim: tool-search.md says manage_connections is present whether or not you are signed in; it is actually gated by the connectors check_fn.

evidence.red: website/docs/user-guide/features/tool-search.md:190-193 on main: "The same tool also installs, enables and authorizes local MCP servers from the catalog (targets with `mcp: true`), so it is present whether or not you are signed in; only the managed-connector actions need the sign-in."
evidence.green: Bundle text: the tool sits behind the same gate as connectors; in the schema only when tools.connectors.enabled is on and the user is on the Nous free tier or signed in to a Portal account with the managed_tools claim; signed-out sessions never see it.
evidence.negative_control: N/A for docs (no executable behaviour). Equivalent check: the stale phrase is present on main and absent on the bundle (grep given in red/green).
evidence.adjacent: python3 website/scripts/check_doc_links.py on the bundle tree: OK (no route-style links). All 7 B1 bundles cherry-pick together onto main cleanly, and each pairs cleanly with B2's current docs2-update/docs2-desktop/docs2-gateway/docs2-memory bundles.
evidence.source: tools/connectors/tool.py:132-146 registry.register(name='manage_connections', ..., check_fn=lambda: gateway_config.connectors_available()); tools/connectors/gateway/config.py:82-106 connectors_available(): False unless load_config().enabled, True for is_guest_state (free tier), else managed_tools_rolled_out() (:68-79, logged_in and managed_tools claim).

upstream_overlap: No open external PR/issue for this claim (gh search prs/issues; open docs PRs touching the same files edit other sections)

bundle.subject: docs(mcp): correct catalog and plugin MCP install docs

notes: Fork wording ('only when the Portal has enabled connectors for the signed-in account') omitted the free-tier path and the tools.connectors.enabled switch; rebuilt wording covers both. No zh-Hans copy of tool-search.md.
